title: Create the five package skeletons
prompt:
Create five packages under packages/: core, log, api, cli, ui. Each has a pyproject.toml (name agent_debate_<pkg>), an __init__.py, and a src layout. core is the SDK; log is the logging package; api/cli/ui are surfaces. Keep each file tiny.

Follow repo standards: TDD (write the failing test first, then code); max 150 lines per code file (split, don't compress); ruff = 0 violations + mypy clean; no hard-coded values (read from config); every external API call goes through the API gatekeeper (Epic 13); log via the LOG package; keep coverage >= 85%. Read docs/PRD.md and the relevant docs/prds/*.md before starting.
note: Token usage from the build harness: 44,476 total tokens over 35 tool uses in ~3m 12s (input/output not separately surfaced, recorded as null). Created packages/{core,log,api,cli,ui}, each with a tiny pyproject.toml (name agent_debate_<pkg>, version 1.00, hatchling) and a src layout (src/agent_debate_<pkg>/__init__.py). TDD: tests/test_packages.py asserts all five import cleanly and declare the right name/src layout (watched it fail, then made it pass). To make `uv sync` install all five into the shared venv, the root pyproject now depends on the five members via [tool.uv.sources] workspace = true. Intra-workspace deps (core/log wiring) are deliberately left empty — that is task 0.3. Gates run: uv sync (green, builds all 6 packages), ruff check (pass), ruff format --check (pass), pytest (12 passed), mypy packages+tests (clean). Skipped gates: 150-line check_line_limit.py (task 0.10, not built — all files are well under 150 lines by inspection) and the coverage>=85% gate (fail_under=0 until task 0.9; skeletons have no runtime code to cover).
